data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gui total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Gui
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Guide, Leader
in_greek.long_meaning: Gui είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'guia,' meaning 'guide' or 'leader.' In Christianity, Gui can represent a spiritual guide or a leader in faith.

in_latin.name: Gui
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Guide, Leader
in_latin.long_meaning: Gui est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'guia,' meaning 'guide' or 'leader.' In Christianity, Gui can represent a spiritual guide or a leader in faith.
